question: Where can a present-day custodian or accession number for station 1078 journals be requested?

sources.contact_role: general directorate/office contact; not archival curator

proposed_request.addressed_to: Лесосибирский педагогический институт — филиал СФУ, общий отдел
proposed_request.objective: Please identify the current custodian, archival fond/opis/delo or accession of station №1078 (Енисейск) observation logs and outgoing КВЦ Космос reports, if surviving.
request_checks: survival and exact custodian of original 1963 station journals
inventory/call number and any digitized scans for 7–9 November 1963
station identifier and date visible in original header
native Soviet/American object designations, time standard, reference frame, observation method, angular uncertainties
if not held here, transfer date, receiving archive and retention/destruction documentation
